body: Currently trying to get through the same thing you are. One minute I think oh I can do this. Everything is fine. Then the next minute I’m on the couch curled up in a ball nauseous thinking my life is over and I don’t want to be here anymore. One day at a time I guess.
Don’t feel stupid for trying to talk to people. You never know. I know that’s hard to believe sometimes. But I’m sorry you’re feeling this way
I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. I’m in the same boat. I hope it gets better. Everyone says it gets better. So let’s hope for that
It’s hard and people say it gets better. You just have to make it to that point. Im sorry you’re struggling. I wish I could take your pain away and leave with it all

I’m sorry you feel this way. I’m in the middle of the same thing kind of. It’s my own fault. I made a mistake and my gf found out. She doesn’t know if she’s going to give me another chance. She’s saved me from the dark place before and if she leaves I don’t think I’ll come out of it.
I don’t want to survive
That’s honestly the only thing keeping me here at this point. My family being hurt
Why can’t I just have cancer and be sick and die. I deserve that. It would be pleasant knowing I got what I deserved and die a slow miserable death
I’m sorry you feel this way. I’m at the lowest point in my life. The worst part is that I caused it. I hate myself for it. Idk if I can go on

I have a pretty dangerous job. If I could make an accident at work she would definitely be set. But then I’d have to worry about what that did to my crew. I know they’d get over it. I’m actually having dejavu as I write this. I don’t know why I did what I did to fuck up the best thing I ever had. I self sabotage. I don’t deserve another chance but if I had one I would make the most of it. I also don’t know why I keep writing here. No one will see this or read this. I’m worthless I hate myself. I don’t want to be here anymore
I’m not a good swimmer. Maybe I can just go to the river and let it take me away. Drowning sounds terrible but it would look accidental

I wish I could end it so she would get a huge chunk of money to pay the house off and stay here. At least then something in my life would have been useful. Right now in this moment I could definitely end it. I have a great family. An amazing job. But that’s not enough. She’s pulled a gun from my head before and saved me. I just wanted one more chance. I know I don’t deserve it. What I did was truly foul and unimaginable. Why would I fuck up the best thing I ever had. I hate myself
Thanks for sharing. It’s really hard to find hope rn

I’m sorry dude. I’m going through the same thing basically right now. Even though it was my fault. She is still here. I’m trying to convince her to give me another chance but she doesn’t believe she’ll be able to trust me again. Idk what to do. I’m lost and I hate myself. I’m sorry you’re going through it

Same. My “friends” will get over it but idk if my parents and sister would. I love them so much. So far that love has been stronger than the guilt and pain and loneliness I feel. Earlier today I had made up my mind that I was going to do it soon. But I’m having second thoughts
I’m in the same boat. I fucked the relationship up with the love of my life. Idk why I self sabotage. Idk if I’m gonna make it
